  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (X[15] != Y[15]) begin
      // Sign bits differ, determine result
      if (X[15] < Y[15]) begin
        result <= 3'b100; // X is greater
      end else begin
        result <= 3'b010; // Y is greater
      end
    end else if (X[14:10] != Y[14:10]) begin
      // Higher order bits differ, determine result
      if (X[14:10] < Y[14:10]) begin
        result <= 3'b100; // X is greater
      end else begin
        result <= 3'b010; // Y is greater

      // Lower order bits differ, determine result
      if (X[9:0] < Y[9:0]) begin
        result <= 3'b100; // X is greater
      end else begin
        result <= 3'b010; // Y is greater
      end
    end else begin
      result <= 3'b001; // X and Y are equal
    end
  end

endmodule

      end
      2'b11: begin // state AB

        out = 1'b1;
      end
    endcase
  end

endmodule
